$comment: The embedding model bundled for semantic workspace search. Gezel's profile owns the identity; these pins must match its model revision and digests (check-embedding-model asserts this). Files are staged in transformers.js cache layout: <repo>/<revision>/<path>. transformers.js also reads config.json from the unversioned <repo>/config.json and would write it there, which a signed, read-only bundle refuses, so that copy is staged too ("unversioned": true).
